messages.content: For user_id user_01 and broker_user_id user_01, please check whether product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black, is in stock in the audio category, then look up popular alternatives in category audio and choose one recommendation for me to buy. Reserve quantity 1 for p_sony_xm5_blk, confirm the order, and note that my items are [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}] with quantity 1. Then generate an invoice for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 using coupon_code SAVE15, send it to alice@company.com, and use payment_gateway paypal with payment_method card. After that, check my investment account status for broker_user_id user_01, confirm that exchange NASDAQ is open, get the USD to EUR rate from from_currency USD to to_currency EUR, look up ticker AAPL’s price, build and place an order to sell sell_quantity 2 shares, assess the trade risk for that transaction amount, and finally create a high-priority app summary/alert for the whole workflow with tags shopping, finance, and audit.
